# OpenOntology 0.3.0-alpha.8

This developer prerelease makes cold opens cheaper and lets hosts read a
construction ledger's version without evaluating it. The public query
operations remain `verify`, `search`, `read`, `check`, and `status`.

## Changes

- Validate native object field evidence against each source's already verified
  bytes during open. Previously the source was re-encoded once per object, so
  sources that pack many objects (curated layers of up to 2,000 records) paid
  objects times source bytes on every cold open.
- Add `readSourceNativeConstructionHead({ options, knowledgeBranch })`, which
  returns the construction ledger head without record evaluation, for hosts
  that only need to know whether the ledger moved.

## Install

```sh
npm install https://github.com/Doss-com/openontology/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.8/oont-0.3.0-alpha.8.tgz
```
